summary: Akanda Corp. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, attaching a press release announcing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice for non-compliance with the minimum stockholders' equity rule (Listing Rule 5550(b)(1)). The notice, received June 16, 2026, follows the company reporting negative equity of -$11.99 million in its annual 20-F. The company has 45 days (until July 31, 2026) to submit a compliance plan; if accepted, Nasdaq may grant up to 180 extra days to cure. There are no deal terms, board actions, or advisor roles. This disclosure is a routine regulatory notification, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle applies.
